svg.text: wireless-esp32-dap - ESP32-C3 SuperMini pins (top view, USB-C up)
NRST (dashed) is optional: OpenOCD resets the target over SWD, so CLK, DIO, 3V3 and GND are enough.
GPIO6 / GPIO7 are the C3 FSPI IO_MUX pins, used by the SWD-over-SPI fast path.
Power the target from 3V only; common ground required, no level shifting.
